scope.unknown_identity_policy: No scored run or patch applicability claim until resolved.

frame_truth.required: Distinct newly produced useful guest game frames correlated to completed renders and successful presentation, with verified source and session identities.
reject_as_game_fps: repeated presentation of one emulated frame
surface or Vulkan present counters without guest/render correlation
frame skipping or altered game speed
coarse FPS polls converted into individual frame times
synthetic, fixture, stale, missing, or incomplete timing data
frame_truth.speed_ratio_definition: Verified guest progress divided by elapsed real time in a declared timing test.

scored_gameplay.mean_fps_definition: Verified distinct useful game frames divided by scored real elapsed seconds, with declared segment boundaries.
scored_gameplay.one_percent_low_definition: For N valid individual game-frame intervals, sort descending, take ceil(0.01*N) slowest intervals, then compute 1000 divided by their mean interval in milliseconds.
scored_gameplay.applies_to: Every scored repeat and scored soak; the rolling gate applies to every scored gameplay window.

repetition.soak_gameplay: Representative active gameplay, not an idle camera.

required: correct guest progression, physics, and QTE timing
visible characters, geometry, gameplay UI, essential effects, lighting, and combat cues
declared visual quality and real internal render dimensions
no incompatible cache or save-state reuse

quality_tiers.reference: Normal game resolution and correctness settings; measure actual dimensions.
quality_tiers.fast: Investigate 960x540-equivalent internal targets, then 1280x720-equivalent if affordable; verify expensive targets change.
quality_tiers.aggressive: Approximately 480-line internal rendering and disclosed cosmetic reductions; evaluate separately.

efficiency.selected_candidate: Lowest repeatably measured energy per verified real game frame among eligible tested candidates in the declared quality tier.
required_measures: energy per real frame with calibrated provenance
process CPU time per real frame

pass_policy: All mandatory scene, FPS, pacing, soak, speed, correctness, save/load, identity, efficiency, and independent Sol Max final review gates must pass for the exact final candidate and evidence hashes. No retroactive threshold weakening may promote a failed run.
